description.en-US: Chesterton's last work of literary biography, on the poet of the Canterbury Tales: the greatness of Chaucer, his age, public and private life, the garden of romance, the Tales, Chaucer as an Englishman and as a medieval, the Renaissance and his religion.
description.pt-BR: A última biografia literária de Chesterton, sobre o poeta dos Contos de Cantuária: a grandeza de Chaucer, sua época, a vida pública e privada, o jardim do romance, os Contos, Chaucer como inglês e como homem medieval, o Renascimento e sua religião.

sources.edition: Chaucer (Faber & Faber, 1932), Project Gutenberg Australia, ebooks13/1300211h.
sources.description: Chapter divisions as printed; Gutenberg front and back matter dropped, line wraps joined, underscored italics converted, double hyphens set as em dashes. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain in Brazil, the UK and the EU (Chesterton died in 1936). Published in 1932; text taken from Project Gutenberg Australia, which carries it under Australian law.

title.en-US: IX. The Moral of the Story
